sbe:messageSchema.description: Requests to tachyon serve and its answers

composite.name: varStringEncoding
composite.description: UTF-8 text: its length in bytes, then the bytes

composite.name: blob
composite.description: Bytes in the data area of the shared memory

validValue.name: Image
validValue.description: A JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP or WebP file, as on disk

validValue.name: Audio
validValue.description: A WAV file, as on disk

enum.name: Kind
enum.description: What a Laya question asks for

validValue.name: Score
validValue.description: A level on an ordered scale

validValue.name: Noul
validValue.description: Whether a statement holds: options false and true

validValue.name: BadRequest
validValue.description: Not a message of this schema, or out of the shared memory

validValue.name: NoModel
validValue.description: No model of that name is pulled or found

validValue.name: Engine
validValue.description: The engine failed: the message says why

validValue.name: TooLarge
validValue.description: The output does not fit the blob it was given

sbe:message.name: Chat
sbe:message.description: The model's answer to a conversation, streamed as Text, then Done

field.name: seed
field.description: Seed of the draws

field.name: keepAliveMs
field.description: How long the model stays in memory after: -1 its own setting, 0 frees it at once

field.name: maxTokens
field.description: 0: until the model ends its turn or the context is full

field.name: topK
field.description: 0: no limit

field.name: temperature
field.description: 0: greedy

field.name: topP
field.description: 1: no limit

field.name: minP
field.description: 0: no limit

field.name: penalty
field.description: Repetition penalty, 1: none

field.name: think
field.description: Lets the model think first; the thinking is part of the text

group.name: attachments
group.description: Images shown before the text, audio played after it

data.name: model
data.description: A pulled model's name, or a directory

sbe:message.name: Embed
sbe:message.description: Embeddings of texts, as f32 rows written to `out`, then Embedded

field.name: out
field.description: Where the rows go: texts × dims × 4 bytes

field.name: dims
field.description: Matryoshka truncation; 0: the model's full size

sbe:message.name: Decide
sbe:message.description: Laya's probabilities for each question's options, as f32 written to `out`, then Decided

field.name: out
field.description: Where the probabilities go, question after question

field.name: conversation
field.description: The state is a conversation

data.name: model
data.description: laya picks laya-english or laya-multilingual by the state's language

sbe:message.name: Load
sbe:message.description: Loads a model ahead of use, or changes how it is kept; then Done

field.name: keepAliveMs
field.description: -1: the daemon's default; -2: never moves out

field.name: context
field.description: Positions of context; 0: the default

field.name: pin
field.description: Never moves out of VRAM, by keep-alive or to make room

sbe:message.name: Unload
sbe:message.description: Drops a model from every tier; then Done

sbe:message.name: Shutdown
sbe:message.description: Ends the daemon once its Done is out: its models are freed, its socket removed

sbe:message.name: Text
sbe:message.description: A piece of a Chat's answer, as it is decoded

field.name: prefillNs
field.description: Chat: reading the prompt, to the first token

field.name: decodeNs
field.description: Chat: the tokens after the first

sbe:message.name: Error
sbe:message.description: A request failed; nothing else follows for it

sbe:message.name: Embedded
sbe:message.description: An Embed's rows are in its `out`

sbe:message.name: Decided
sbe:message.description: A Decide's probabilities are in its `out`: each question's options in order

field.name: vramBytes
field.description: VRAM it takes, its towers included; 0 out of VRAM

field.name: keepAliveMs
field.description: Left before it is freed to disk; -1 never

sbe:message.name: Welcome
sbe:message.description: The daemon's first and only message on the socket

field.name: size
field.description: Bytes of the shared memory to map
